transcript.content: Hello. What brings you in to see me today?

I'm really anxious about talking about this, but I feel like I'm constantly being watched and monitored by people wherever I go. It feels like they are targeting me, and this has been going on for about a year and a half now.
Besides feeling watched, have you ever heard voices or seen things that other people can't see or hear?
No, I have never heard any voices or seen things that other people cannot see or hear. It's just the constant monitoring and feeling of being targeted that is actually happening to me.
During this past year and a half, have you experienced periods of feeling very depressed, or times when you felt unusually high, energetic, or hyperactive?

No, I haven't really experienced those kinds of extreme mood swings during this time. I don't get super depressed, and I've never felt unusually high or hyperactive. It's mostly just been the constant worry about being monitored.
Have you had any difficulty keeping your thoughts organized, or have others mentioned that your speech is hard to follow?
No, I haven't really noticed any difficulty keeping my thoughts organized. No one has ever mentioned to me that my speech is hard to follow, either.
Have you noticed a major drop in your motivation to do daily activities, or has it felt harder for you to express or feel emotions lately?
Yes, actually, I've had almost no motivation to do basic daily tasks lately. I also feel very flat, and it's become really hard for me to show or even feel emotions anymore.
How have these struggles with motivation and feeling watched affected your ability to work, maintain relationships, or take care of yourself?

It has ruined everything because I'm too terrified to go outside where they are watching me, so I've completely isolated myself from my friends and family. I also just don't have the motivation to do basic chores, keep up with work, or even take care of my basic hygiene. I feel completely paralyzed and overwhelmed by it all.
Have you or those close to you noticed any unusual physical behaviors, or times when you found yourself unable to move or reacting in strange ways?

Yes, there are times when I feel completely frozen and unable to move at all, like my body just locks up. My family has also pointed out that I sometimes hold odd positions for a long time or make strange facial expressions without realizing it. It's really confusing and honestly quite scary when it happens.

Therefore, the only remaining candidate is Schizophrenia.
